english.note: Use this when the drabness is experienced as a tedious or oppressive atmosphere, especially in daily life.

examples.english: There is a real sense of drabness in this house when nobody talks for so long.
examples.traditional: 呢間屋成日冇人講嘢，坐耐咗真係有種沉悶感。
